answer.line: Both parts of 1.1 come out, the 1 and the 0.1: 24.9 - 1.1 = 23.8 kg.

steps: Estimate first: a little over 1 kg out of nearly 25 leaves just under 24.
Line up the points. Tenths: 9 - 1 = 8. Ones and tens: 24 - 1 = 23.
So the crate weighs 23.8 kg. Every digit of 1.1 comes off its own column.

choices.note: Right digits, point one place too far left. Taking about 1 kg from about 25 leaves about 24, not about 2.
The 1 and the 0.1 both come off.
24.9 - 1 = 23.9 takes off the 1 but leaves the 0.1 behind. All 1.1 kg came out.
24.9 + 1.1 = 26.0 adds the packing back in. It was taken out, so subtract.
Right digits with the point dropped: 238 kg is ten times the whole crate.

lockIt: Subtract decimals place by place: each digit taken out comes off its own column.

visual.caption: Both marked digits of 1.1 leave their own columns. Take off only the 1 and you land on 23.9.
